v: pu॰ avavajYAtaH ninditaH KAdaH KAdyam prA॰ sa॰ । ninditaKAdye “nAtrAvaKAdo asti vaH” f॰ 1, 4 vf, 4 “avaKAdaH avajYAtaH KAdaH jugupsitahavirviSezaH” BA॰ ।
m: अव-खाद m. ‘a devourer, destroyer’ [Gmn.], or mfn. ‘devouring, destroying’ [NBD.], RV. i, 41, 4.
(accord. to others fr. √ खद् = खिद्, ‘hindrance, annoyance’).
a: अवखादः — [अवज्ञातः निंदितः खादः खाद्यं] Bad or contemptible meal; an unworthy oblation.
अवखंड् — {c10c} P. 1 To cut down, break into pieces. --2 To waste away, wear away; अर्धयाममात्रावखंडितायां विभावर्यां K. 49 when the night had advanced only half a watch. --3 To destroy, annihilate.

m: अव-√ खण्ड् -खण्डयति, to break into pieces, BhP.; Kād.; to annihilate, destroy Comm. on BṛĀrUp.
अव-खण्डन n. breaking into pieces, Kād.
अव-√ ख्या (Imper. 2. pl. -ख्यत; impf. अव-ख्यत्) to look down, RV. viii, 47, 11; (with acc.) to see, perceive, RV. i, 161, 4 and x, 27, 3; TS. : Caus. -ख्यापयति, to cause to look at, ŚBr.
